data.long_meaning: In Greek, Yolane is derived from the Greek name Io, which means ‘dew’, and the Hebrew name El, meaning ‘God’. Combined, Yolane means ‘Dew of Yahweh’ or ‘God’s Dew’. In ancient Greece, Io was a goddess of the earth and the sea, associated with fertility and abundance. In Christian tradition, Yolane is a symbol of divine grace, renewal, and the blessings of God.
